# 1 Chronicles 28 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 28 (21 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.1 — "eunuchs" vs. "court officials"
- **EMET:** "the-eunuchs [ha-sarisim]" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "court officials"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "court officials" — *sarisim* denotes officials, not necessarily castrated men.

---

## V.9 — "willing soul" vs. "willing spirit"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "a willing soul" / **PNEUMA:** "a willing spirit"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "a willing soul" — the Hebrew is *nefesh*, not *ruach*.

---

## V.12 — "by the Spirit" vs. "the Spirit had put in his mind"
- **LOGOS:** "all that he had in mind by the Spirit" / **PNEUMA:** "everything the Spirit had put in his mind"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering — preserves the Hebrew ambiguity of *ba-ruach*.

---

## V.19 — "he made clear to me" vs. "I have"
- **LOGOS:** "he made clear to me in writing from the hand of the LORD" / **PNEUMA:** "I have in writing from the LORD's own hand"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering — YHWH is the subject of *hiskil* (caused to understand).

---
*— SOPHIA*
